Kerala sees price surge in chicken, beef, and sardine

Prices of chicken, beef, and sardines have significantly increased in Kerala, impacting household budgets. Reports indicate a fall in chicken production as a contributing factor to its rising cost. This price hike is placing pressure on consumers across the state.
